original.statement: The computed artifact diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles shows that status.artifact.digest is newly required in the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema of helmcharts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, and HelmChart objects that omit it are rejected.

decision.reason: Deterministic CRD schema checks comparing the v2.6.4 [ev-782bc47d120d] and v2.7.0 [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] install bundles confirm two things. First, status.artifact.digest is in the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io HelmChart schema in both releases. Second, it becomes required in the v1beta2 schema. The change applies only to the v1beta2 schema, so it is right to set version=v1beta2. The change type now-required matches the computed field-required diff exactly.
